extensionName.message: Shorts Flow: Auto-Scroll for YouTube Shorts
extensionName.description: Full extension name shown in the browser and on the stores. Keep "for YouTube Shorts": never suggest YouTube made Shorts Flow.

extensionShortName.description: Short extension name, also the toolbar button tooltip.

extensionDescription.message: Watch YouTube Shorts hands-free: Shorts Flow moves to the next Short when the current one finishes. Not affiliated with YouTube.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser and on the stores (at most 132 characters).

popupTitle.description: Document title and heading of the Popup, the panel that opens from the toolbar icon.

popupVersion.description: Accessible name of the version chip in the Popup's header.

popupWhatsNewUnread.description: Accessible name of the dot on the Popup's version chip, shown after an update until the viewer opens What's new.

popupAutoScroll.description: Name of the Auto-Scroll switch: Shorts Flow moves to the next Short when the current one ends.

popupAutoScrollOn.message: Moves on when a Short ends
popupAutoScrollOn.description: Under the Auto-Scroll switch while it is on.

popupAutoScrollOff.message: Each Short loops until you swipe
popupAutoScrollOff.description: Under the Auto-Scroll switch while it is off.

popupOnShortsFeed.description: Status line: the tab the Popup opened over is on the Shorts Feed, so Shorts Flow is at work there.

popupOffShortsFeed.description: Status line: the tab the Popup opened over is not on the Shorts Feed, so Shorts Flow does nothing there.

popupShortsWatched.description: Status line, after whether the tab is on the Shorts Feed: how many Shorts the viewer has watched in the current Session, one continuous stretch of watching that ends after 30 minutes with no Short playing.

popupSessionLimit.description: Popup label of the optional Session Limit: a Break Nudge after a number of Shorts or minutes in one Session, one continuous stretch of watching the Shorts Feed.

popupSessionLimitHintOff.message: Pause for a break after a while
popupSessionLimitHintOff.description: Under the Session Limit while it is off: what setting one does.

popupSessionLimitOff.description: Popup choice for the Session Limit: no limit.

popupSessionLimitShorts.description: Popup choice for the Session Limit: a number of Shorts Watched.

popupSessionLimitMinutes.description: Popup choice for the Session Limit: a number of minutes of Shorts playing.

popupSessionLimitShortsValue.description: What screen readers call the Popup's number field for a Session Limit in Shorts.

popupSessionLimitMinutesValue.description: What screen readers call the Popup's number field for a Session Limit in minutes.

popupSessionLimitProgressShorts.description: Under the Session Limit: Shorts Watched towards a limit in Shorts, since the last Break Nudge.

popupSessionLimitProgressMinutes.description: Under the Session Limit: minutes of Shorts playing towards a limit in minutes, since the last Break Nudge.

popupHostAccessLost.description: Firefox only: heading of the notice shown when the viewer turned off Shorts Flow's access to youtube.com.

popupHostAccessHint.message: Its access to youtube.com is turned off, so it can't move Shorts on.
popupHostAccessHint.description: Firefox only: explains the notice about access to youtube.com.

popupHostAccessRestore.description: Firefox only: button that asks Firefox to give Shorts Flow its access to youtube.com back.

popupSkipSponsored.description: Name of the switch that skips a Sponsored Short (an ad YouTube puts in the Shorts Feed) as soon as it comes up. It skips, it does not block ads: never say "block".

popupSkipSponsoredOn.message: Moves past them as soon as one comes up
popupSkipSponsoredOn.description: Under the Skip Sponsored Shorts switch while it is on.

popupSkipSponsoredOff.message: They play like any other Short
popupSkipSponsoredOff.description: Under the Skip Sponsored Shorts switch while it is off.

popupSettings.description: Accessible name of the Popup's list of settings.

popupShortsControlShown.description: Popup switch: whether the Shorts Control, Shorts Flow's Auto-Scroll button beside each Short on YouTube, is shown.

popupShortsControlShownHint.message: An Auto-Scroll button beside each Short
popupShortsControlShownHint.description: Under the "Show button on Shorts" switch: what the button is.

popupSpeed.description: Name of the Speed switch in the Popup: every Short plays at the Preferred Speed while it is on.

popupSpeedOn.description: Under the Speed switch while it is on: each new Short plays at the Preferred Speed picked beside it.

popupSpeedOff.description: Under the Speed switch while it is off: Shorts play at whatever speed YouTube sets.

popupPreferredSpeed.description: Accessible name of the picker for the Preferred Speed, the playback speed Speed keeps across reloads.

popupSpeedValue.description: One playback speed in the Preferred Speed picker, such as 1.5×.

popupShortcuts.description: Name of the Popup row listing the Shortcuts: single keys that switch Auto-Scroll and Speed on the Shorts Feed.

popupShortcutsHint.message: Single keys on the Shorts Feed
popupShortcutsHint.description: Under the Shortcuts row's name: the Shortcuts work on the Shorts Feed only. Pressing a key's button rebinds it.

popupShortcutsListening.message: Press the new key, or Esc to keep it
popupShortcutsListening.description: Under the Shortcuts row's name while it waits for the viewer to press a Shortcut's new key.

popupShortcutKey.description: Accessible name of a Shortcut's key button in the Popup, such as "Auto-Scroll Shortcut: A". Pressing it rebinds the key.

popupPressKey.description: Shown in place of a Shortcut's key while the Popup waits for its new key. Keep it short: it fits in a small keycap.

popupKeyTaken.description: The viewer tried to give a Shortcut the key another Shortcut has; it is refused.

popupKeyYouTube.message: $KEY$ is one of YouTube's own keys
popupKeyYouTube.description: The viewer tried to give a Shortcut a key YouTube itself uses on Shorts (moving between Shorts, pausing, muting, ...); it is refused so YouTube's keys keep working.

popupWhatsNew.description: Popup link to news about recent versions on the Shorts Flow website.

popupReportProblem.description: Popup link to the Report Page on the Shorts Flow website.

popupSupport.description: Popup link to the Support Page on the Shorts Flow website, to rate, share or donate.

stallNotice.description: Stall notice: a small toast on the Shorts Feed when Shorts Flow asked YouTube for the next Short and none came. Keep it short and calm.

stallRetry.description: Button on the Stall notice that asks YouTube for the next Short again.

breakNudgeTitle.description: Title of the Break Nudge, the calm notice over the Shorts Feed when the viewer reaches the Session Limit they set. No guilt-trip wording.

breakNudgeText.message: You've reached the Session Limit you set. Take a moment, or keep watching.
breakNudgeText.description: Text under the Break Nudge's title. Calm, no guilt-trip wording, no numbers or countdown.

breakNudgeKeepWatching.description: The Break Nudge's only button, also chosen by Space, Enter or Escape: the Short plays on, and the next Break Nudge comes only after another full Session Limit.

shortcutAutoScrollOn.description: Brief confirmation on the Shorts Feed after the viewer turned Auto-Scroll on with its Shortcut (A by default).

shortcutAutoScrollOff.description: Brief confirmation on the Shorts Feed after the viewer turned Auto-Scroll off with its Shortcut.

shortcutSpeedOn.description: Brief confirmation on the Shorts Feed after the viewer turned Speed on with its Shortcut (S by default), with the Preferred Speed Shorts now play at.

shortcutSpeedOff.description: Brief confirmation on the Shorts Feed after the viewer turned Speed off with its Shortcut: Shorts play at YouTube's own speed again.

shortsControlName.description: Shorts Control: name of the Auto-Scroll button Shorts Flow adds to YouTube's row of buttons beside each Short, shown under it like YouTube's "Share". Keep it very short: it has about 64 px.

shortsControlTurnOff.description: Shorts Control: tooltip while Auto-Scroll is on, saying what a click does.

shortsControlTurnOn.description: Shorts Control: tooltip while Auto-Scroll is off, saying what a click does.

quickSettingsName.description: Name of the small menu off the Shorts Control (the Auto-Scroll button in YouTube's row of buttons beside each Short), and of the small button that opens it. It holds Skip Sponsored Shorts, Speed and the Preferred Speed.

quickSettingsSkipSponsored.description: Quick settings menu: the switch that skips a Sponsored Short (an ad YouTube puts in the Shorts Feed) as soon as it comes up. Same wording as the Popup's switch. It skips, it does not block ads: never say "block".

quickSettingsSpeed.description: Quick settings menu: the Speed switch. While it is on, every Short plays at the Preferred Speed.

quickSettingsPreferredSpeed.description: Quick settings menu: the item showing the Preferred Speed, which opens the list of speeds to pick from; also the title of that list.

quickSettingsSpeedValue.description: One playback speed in the Quick settings menu, such as 1.5×.

quickSettingsBack.description: Accessible name of the item at the top of the list of speeds, which goes back to the Quick settings menu.
